title: Gridlike 3d-4f heterometallic macrocycles for highly efficient conversion of CO2 into cyclic carbonates

synthesis.procedure: ZnCl2 (0.1 mmol) was added to a suspension of H4L (0.15 mmol) in 0.5 mL DMF. Then 25 μL (0.2 mmol) triethylamine was added and the mixture was stirred for 20 min. Ln(NO3)3·6H2O (0.2 mmol, Ln = Eu for 1) together with 2 mL methanol and 0.5 mL isopropanol were added sequentially. The mixture was stirred for 1 h, filtered, and crystallized at 65 °C. Colorless crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained after about 4 days (results section also describes a related self-assembly of four equivalents ZnCl2 and eight equivalents LnCl3·6H2O with six equivalents H4L in DMF/methanol/isopropanol 1:4:1 with triethylamine, giving light yellow crystals after four days).
synthesis.time: stirred 20 min after base, then 1 h after Ln salt; crystals after about 4 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution self-assembly followed by filtration and crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: mixture stirred then filtered; crystallization at 65 °C afforded crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction after about 4 days

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same general method as 1: ZnCl2 (0.1 mmol) was added to a suspension of H4L (0.15 mmol) in 0.5 mL DMF. Then 25 μL (0.2 mmol) triethylamine was added and the mixture was stirred for 20 min. Ln(NO3)3·6H2O (0.2 mmol, Ln = Tb for 2) together with 2 mL methanol and 0.5 mL isopropanol were added sequentially. The mixture was stirred for 1 h, filtered, and crystallized at 65 °C. Colorless crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained after about 4 days. Complexes 1 and 2 are isostructural.
